<!-- A short description is enough; no architecture proposal is required.
     Use a small example without tokens, secrets, or private stored data. -->

## Intended user behavior

What should a Discord or Twitch user be able to do? Who may use it?

## Unsupported operation

What cannot be expressed with the current public framework helpers? Mention
the helper you tried, a missing permission, new service access, or API change.

## State ownership

Does this need no state, group-local state, or standalone state that becomes
shared through a selected integration? Does deployed data need preserving?
If unsure, describe the desired behavior before and after linking.

## Small example

Give one command invocation and expected result, pseudocode, or a focused
failing test. Link your feature or draft PR if one exists.
